name: novatrix-background
title: Novatrix Background
description: A full-bleed animated background of flowing pastel bands in mint, pink and purple, like light folding through silk. It drifts on its own and can be set to lean toward the pointer.
use: A landing or hero area wants a soft moving backdrop behind text without images or video.
avoid: It is a full-bleed canvas needing a sized parent, and the bright field clashes with white or high-contrast text.
a11y: The shader animates forever with no pause or reduced-motion handling, and the canvas is purely decorative. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The whole frame is filled with smooth, glossy bands of pale mint, bubblegum pink, lavender and white, curving into folds and hollows with no text or controls. The palette is light and high-key.
behaves: The bands slide and fold continuously in a slow loop, so no shape ever settles. With pointer response switched on, the pattern drifts slightly toward the cursor.
customise: Tune the overall tint through the color prop, adjust speed and amplitude, and toggle pointer response with mouseReact; the shader itself needs a source edit.
weight: heavy: A WebGL fragment shader redrawing every frame with an eight-step loop per pixel.
